imagery.method: Reviewed individual satellite captures for all 133 active Fire/EMS sites; average image scale 0.2155851582395278 m/pixel. Each area is estimated around visible building/frontage, immediate parking/apron and observable access; exact boundaries/entrances are not surveyed.

limits: No official parcel or building-footprint polygons were used.
Dimensions, centers, rotation and spawn coordinates are imagery/road-geometry estimates, not surveyed measurements.
Imagery does not verify apparatus doors, gates, access controls, current pavement, or building occupancy.
Canonical IDs and source coordinates remain unchanged.

Collision QA follows an actual city route from each spawn until at least 10 m beyond the fitted yard, then resolves movement in 1.5 m steps; this verifies the modeled collision transition, not sustained manual driving or real-world emergency-response suitability.
The 13 co-located Fire/EMS pairs reuse a shared imagery fit; this does not establish EMS-only bays or entrances.
